title: Involvement and distinctions
exampleQuestions: Is he involved in any association?
answer: Since May 2026 Hamza is General Secretary of AEDI, the Computer Science student association. He is also a laureate of the Georges Besse Foundation, a merit-based support program for engineering students, and follows INSA Lyon's Entrepreneurship Track (2026 to 2027), a program on turning concrete problems into viable products.
